title: Bound scalar evaluation by homogeneous coefficients
statement: Let n∈ℕ, R∈BinaryForm ℂ n, z∈ℂ, and b∈ℝ with b≥0. Suppose every monomial coefficient of R has absolute value at most b. Then |R(1,−z)|≤(n+1)max(1,|z|)^n b.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (z : ℂ) (b : ℝ), 0 ≤ b → (∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, ‖MvPolynomial.coeff d R.val‖ ≤ b) → ‖MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -z) R.val‖ ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (max 1 ‖z‖) ^ n * b
